We need to update the note below which says

> Hiding a dialog is different from closing one. Closing a dialog gives it a return value, fires an event, unblocks the page for other dialogs, and so on. Whereas hiding a dialog is a purely visual property, and is something you can already do with the [hidden](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#attr-hidden) attribute or by removing the [open](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#attr-dialog-open) attribute. (See also the [note above](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#note-dialog-remove-open-attribute) about removing the [open](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#attr-dialog-open) attribute, and how hiding the dialog in that way is generally not desired.)

We can just delete everything after "the hidden attribute", I think.
